description: A strict nixd configuration patch for --config, .nixd.json, or the editor's nixd section.

$schema.description: The schema used to validate this configuration patch.

diagnostic.description: Diagnostic configuration. An empty object is a no-op.

suppress.description: Diagnostic short names to suppress. An empty array clears the suppression list.

formatting.description: A non-empty formatter program shorthand, or formatter configuration. An empty command array causes formatting requests to return no edits.

command.description: The formatter program and arguments. An empty array causes formatting requests to return no edits.

nixpkgs.description: Package provider configuration. An empty object is a no-op and an empty expr clears the provider.

expr.description: A Nix expression evaluating to the package set. An empty string clears the provider.
A non-empty Nix expression evaluating to option declarations.

options.description: The complete named option-provider map. An empty object clears every provider.

title: JSON schema for a nixd configuration patch
